description: tests/hud-negative/minimap-wrong.json, the ui_hud_corpus_wrong control (PL.native-hud-rows): core's minimap corpus (conformance/ui/minimap-cases.json at the pin) cut to one case of each op and doctored. The contract states the settlements feed's id prefix as town_ (the rows ingest a settlement as settlement_<id>). The runner must name it and FAIL.
sources: Rules moved from babylon packages/babylon/src/engine/game-engine/ui/minimap-model.ts (babylon origin/main bfcdeb2, 279 lines) into core src/ui/minimap-model.ts unchanged; placed() takes the theme as an argument instead of defaulting to Babylon's uiTheme().

contract.projection: x = ((p.x + w/2) / w) * size - size/2; y = ((p.z + w/2) / w) * size - size/2
contract.projectionNote: projection is Babylon's rule, used when no northYaw is given; under the default north it draws north DOWN and so mirrors the world. Every engine binds projectionNorthUp
contract.projectionNorthUp: with northYaw n (the world's, from worldNorth): k = size / w; east = (cos n, -sin n), north = (sin n, cos n); x = (p.x * east.x + p.z * east.z) * k; y = -(p.x * north.x + p.z * north.z) * k (north up, east right)
contract.projectionMirrored: a mirrored level (the compass contract's mirroredLevel) passes mirrored: true with its northYaw: x is negated (north up, east LEFT, as the level shows it from above); y is unchanged. mirrored without a northYaw throws
